# hookbase_filter (Resource)

Manages a Hookbase filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Filter for high-value transactions only
resource "hookbase_filter" "high_value" {
  name  = "high-value-orders"
  logic = "AND"
  conditions = jsonencode([
    {
      field    = "data.object.amount"
      operator = "greater_than"
      value    = "10000"
    },
    {
      field    = "data.object.currency"
      operator = "equals"
      value    = "usd"
    }
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `conditions` (String) JSON string of conditions array. Each condition has field, operator, and value.
- `name` (String) Filter name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Filter description.
- `logic` (String) Logic operator for combining conditions: AND or OR.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe identifier. Auto-generated from name if not provided. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Filter ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
